verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Resend offers registrable webhooks for email events (create-webhook API, headless webhook management). Nothing in the pack mentions signed payloads, signing secrets, or documented signature-verification code. Webhook existence is an adjacent feature and does not show authenticity verification, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify webhook authenticity — signed payloads with documented signature verification code — so spoofed events can't poison my delivery state
